description: List the LOCAL agent(s) registered from THIS machine — the desktop agent running on the box this MCP is on. Use for a LOCAL tc_run / suite_run. There is exactly one desktop agent per machine, so this is 0 or 1 row: empty means no agent is registered from this box (start the SimplifyQA desktop agent, or use mode:'remote' to dispatch to a teammate's). Use `remote_agents` for the other registered machines. Requires a live connection.
name: local_agents
title: List THIS machine's local agent(s)
